item.title: BYD’s Racco kei EV makes splash in Japan, but can it hit 10k?
item.summary: Japan's kei segment has been impenetrable to foreign OEMs for decades, but BYD has a chance to carve out a real niche. By Stewart Burnett The post BYD’s Racco kei EV makes splash in Japan, but can it hit 10k? appeared first on Automotive World .
